mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 40 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park under the glow of a full moon. You can spot the ISS tonight starting at 6:38 PM; it will rise in the northwest near Verona High School and travel low across the horizon toward the east northeast over Fitchburg. Expect an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

City buildings will be closed this coming Thursday and Friday for the holiday. Please remember that refuse and recycling pickup normally scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday, November 27.

We have a full week of local fun, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, plus yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness and various trivia nights starting Tuesday at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy incident from November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue resulted in an arrest for O W I with a minor passenger in the vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10 PM tonight.
